abilities.name: Wayfinding

abilities.name: Greenlore

abilities.description: Field medicine and plant knowledge: remedies, poultices, antidotes, and what's safe to eat.
abilities.notFor: Surgery or broken bones beyond splinting; instant effects (remedies take time); anything without materials to hand.

tree.name: Hedge Remedy

tree.cannot: Can't treat serious wounds or strong toxins; needs local plants and an hour.

tree.name: Deep Pharmacopeia

tree.cannot: Precursor-touched afflictions resist; can't stockpile — preparations spoil in days.

tree.name: Old Recipes

abilities.name: Carrying Call
abilities.narrationHints: Not Harmonic craft — the folk version, learned by living downstream of it. A call pitched to carry: over water, around a bend, through a mill's noise. Every valley child can do a little of this and nobody calls it a craft.
abilities.description: The valley's borrowed sound-work. Generations beside the Choir and the echo-crossings, and what came of it is a way of shouting that works.
abilities.notFor: Anything a Harmonic would recognise as craft — no barriers, no shattering, no woven overtones; carrying a message nobody is listening for; working where there is nothing to carry along (open flat ground kills it).

tree.name: Call That Carries
tree.grants: Pitch a call so it travels — up a valley, across a lake, through a working mill — and arrives understandable to someone a mile off who knows the call. ⚠️ Also READS one back: you can tell distance and rough direction from an answering call.
tree.cannot: IT NEEDS SOMETHING TO CARRY ALONG — water, a valley wall, a still evening. Open flat ground eats it. And it is a CALL: anyone in between hears it too, including whoever you were avoiding.

tree.name: Worked Line
tree.grants: Set a chain of calls along a route — a mill-line, a river run, a ridge — so word travels the valley faster than a rider.
tree.cannot: You need people at the stations who know the calls, which means the calls are known, which means they can be read by anyone who learned them. Valley call-lines have been used against the valley before.

tree.name: Whole Valley Hears
tree.grants: A call the entire settled valley picks up and passes — flood, fire, a column on the road. It has been used four times in living memory and everyone knows all four.
tree.cannot: ⚠️ IT CANNOT BE UNSAID AND IT CANNOT BE QUIET. You have told everyone, including the thing you are calling about. A false raising costs a family its standing for a generation.

abilities.name: Glasswork
abilities.narrationHints: Not Radiant craft — the folk version. Valley glass, valley mirrors, valley lamps: catching light, throwing it where you need it, and knowing by eye what a piece of glass will do before you cut it.
abilities.description: What a people learn from living under the plateau edge. No coherent beams, no mirage — a lens, a signal, a lamp that gets light down a mineshaft.
abilities.notFor: Anything a Radiant would call craft — no bending light around a body, no searing beam, no spectra-sight; making light where there is none; working in true dark.

tree.name: Caught Light
tree.grants: Work glass and mirror to put light where it does not reach — down a shaft, around a corner, into a wound you are trying to close — or throw a signal flash to a ridge in daylight. ⚠️ And you can READ a piece of glass by eye: what it will do, where it will fail, whether it was ground or found.
tree.cannot: THERE MUST BE LIGHT TO CATCH. This makes none. In true dark it is a bag of glass. And a signal flash is seen by everyone with a line of sight to the ridge.

tree.name: Set Piece
tree.grants: Build a standing arrangement — a lamp-run that lights a whole works, a mirror-line that watches a road, a lens that starts a fire from noon sun.
tree.cannot: It is FIXED where you built it and it takes hours. Weather, dust and a curious child all defeat it.

tree.name: Valley Glass
tree.grants: The good work: a lens that shows you what is on the far ridge, a mirror-chain that carries a signal the length of the settled valley, a lamp that burns a night on a thumb of oil.
tree.cannot: ⚠️ YOU ARE NOW WORTH ROBBING. Valley glass of this quality is the most portable wealth a farming family will ever hold, and everyone who has seen it knows where it lives.
